name: cognizant.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 759 images have no alt attribute.
lesson: Describe what each image shows in its alt attribute, and use alt="" on purely decorative ones.
summary: www.cognizant.com scores 73 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 21 are at risk, and 28 pass. Fix first: 759 images have no alt attribute.

fix.title: 759 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 148 language alternate problems
fix.evidence: /us/en does not link back to /ca/en, /us/en does not link back to /ca/fr, /mx/en has no self reference and 145 more.
fix.fix: Each language version must list every version, itself included, and each must link back.

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: The start page does not declare its language
fix.evidence: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and browsers offer the wrong translation.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /us/en/enterprise-ai-builder, /us/en/services/ai/enterprise-physical-ai-autonomy, for example a[data-video-id="oYcDmIp3Wrw"] and a[data-video-id="1U7cHyIodNQ"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on 80 of 81 pages analyzed.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page arrived in 410 ms
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
